title: On Sewing the whole seam by hand
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：sew　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sew 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the farmer ① sewed the whole seam by hand without complaint, and every child in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three autumns on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the farmer ② sews the whole seam by hand with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ sew the whole seam by hand at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ sewn the whole seam by hand before — a line in the almanac for September 1949 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Sewing the whole seam by hand without complaint, the farmer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ sew the torn coat in half an hour with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Sew the torn coat in half an hour at once and never mention it again.

By 1962 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the almanac, and a new child from the next field ⑧ sews the torn coat in half an hour without complaint every autumn without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the fence, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ sewed the whole seam by hand again when nobody else would.

⑩ To sew the whole seam by hand, my mother said in 1967, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody sews the whole seam by hand with great care again and somebody must sew the whole seam by hand without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 缝制（一般过去式 sewed the whole seam by hand：1955 年农人头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 缝制（一般现在 sews the whole seam by hand：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 缝制（不定式 to sew the whole seam by hand：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 缝制（过去完成时 had sewn the whole seam by hand：1949 年九月的农事历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 缝制（动名词 sewing the whole seam by hand 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 缝补（sew the torn coat in half an hour：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去缝补半个钟头把那件破外衣补好）
G. v. 缝补（sew the torn coat in half an hour：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 缝制（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 sews the torn coat in half an hour，而母亲又一次 sewed the whole seam by hand）

answers.why: sew 意为“缝制”，1955 年农人毫无怨言地缝制把整条缝线用手缝起来，那是田垄里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 sewed。
sew 意为“缝制”，自那以后农人小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 sews。
sew 意为“缝制”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯缝制把整条缝线用手缝起来”，此处为不定式 to sew the whole seam by hand。
sew 意为“缝制”，农事历里 九月 那行字说明早在 1962 年之前就有人缝制过，故用过去完成时 had sewn。
sew 意为“缝制”，农人说“缝制把整条缝线用手缝起来这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 sewing the whole seam by hand 作主语。
sew 意为“缝补”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去缝补半个钟头把那件破外衣补好”，should ever 之后用原形 sew the torn coat in half an hour。
sew 意为“缝补”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻缝补半个钟头把那件破外衣补好（sew the torn coat in half an hour at once），以后再也不要提起。
sew 意为“缝制”，新来的孩子每个秋天都照例缝补半个钟头把那件破外衣补好，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 sews。
sew 意为“缝制”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地缝制把整条缝线用手缝起来，用一般过去式 sewed 叙述。
sew 意为“缝制”，结尾那句是母亲 1967 年的话：要缝制把整条缝线用手缝起来，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和田垄记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sew 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the farmer sewed the whole seam by hand without complaint, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the farmer sews the whole seam by hand with great care whenever the field asks.
Sewing the whole seam by hand without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever sew the torn coat in half an hour with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next field sews the torn coat in half an hour without complaint every autumn, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother sewed the whole seam by hand again, and the field remembered that half.
